title: Electro House
tagline: A club-friendly form that leans on crisp hooks and punchy low end.
summary: Electro house builds on house rhythm but pushes the track toward brighter synth lines, more obvious hooks and stronger accent patterns. It thrives in festivals and late-night sets, where the listener feels the beat as much as the melody. The sound is often clean, direct and built for movement.

pillars.name: Justice
pillars.why: Justice made the style feel sharp and graphic, pairing bright synths with a strong sense of impact.

pillars.name: Simian Mobile Disco
pillars.why: Simian Mobile Disco brought a playful, highly rhythmic energy to the sound without losing the club focus.

pillars.name: Steve Aoki
pillars.why: Steve Aoki helped turn electro house into a bigger, more theatrical live experience.
